links.outcome: Student exam accuracy and time with chatbot vs textbook, app, or no support tool
links.effect: All support tools improved accuracy vs control (P<.05); ChatGPT-4o mean accuracy 86.40% (SD 6.38%); chatbot and app groups needed significantly less time than textbook group (P<.05).
links.quote: All support tools led to a significantly higher accuracy compared with the control group (P<.05), with mean accuracies of 87.47% (SD 5.63%), 86.40% (SD 5.19%), and 86.40% (SD 6.38%) for the textbook, the AcciDent app, and ChatGPT-4o, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Prompt quality training to improve chatbot response clarity and user accuracy in dental education

screen.reason: The study evaluates dental students using ChatGPT-4o versus other educational tools in a simulated exam on dental trauma management. It does not compare organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
